intro: Bloodvenom Post is a remote Horde settlement perched on the rocky bluffs of western Felwood overlooking Darkshore. Its tauren-style structures and tauren guards provide a foothold in a region infested with demonic taint and corrupted wildlife.

p: Tucked away along the high cliffs above Darkshore, Bloodvenom Post is reached by following the corrupted southern bank of the Bloodvenom River away from Felwood's main thoroughfare. Built with traditional tauren tents, totems, and watch posts, this encampment provides Horde wanderers with a vital base of operations amidst a dying forest. From here, scouts track the encroaching demonic forces, study the spreading corruption of the waters, and attempt to monitor the hostile wildlife mutated by the Burning Legion's lingering power.

Beyond observing the tainted wilds of Felwood, the camp sits right upon the precipice peering down over northern Darkshore. Its isolated position serves a double duty: keeping Horde forces informed of night elf movements along the western coastline while remaining well out of easy reach of Alliance patrols traversing the forest's central road.
